statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The purpose is to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances and evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The denial reason code is CO-97
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
